Extra whole-document counting is conservative and does not loosen cap. Runtime monitoring records sampled /proc VmRSS and actual affinity/thread count; sampled RSS is not an exact peak claim.

Timeout7200s covers owned job wall; assertion/timeout/state-write errors within owned try cause terminate/wait10/kill/wait, with cleanup and preserved partial. Successful/nonzero child is waited via poll, receipt appended, active cleared and nonzero rejected.

Two complete native successful jobs plus after-job stat checks are required before final NATIVE_COMPLETE_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_GT_EVALUATION; no response-driven cancel, parameter choice or GT/quality evaluation in runner.

engineering_note.previous_issue: Child can finish after poll() but before /proc status parsing; zombie status may lack VmRSS, causing administrative rejection of a successful native job.
engineering_note.reviewed_fix: Parse proc_fields; when Threads or VmRSS is absent, break only if poll confirms termination; an actually live child lacking fields raises fatal. Existing resource/thread/affinity assertions and owned terminate/wait/kill cleanup remain.
